Use case: object/icon atlas of farm item icons

Subject: coin = shiny gold coin with a simple wheat-ear emboss; radish = round pink-red radish with green leaves; carrot = orange carrot with leafy green top; potato = two brown potatoes; wheat = bundle of golden wheat ears tied with string; sunflower = big yellow sunflower head with brown centre; pumpkin = fat orange pumpkin with a short stem; egg = one white-cream chicken egg; milk = glass milk bottle with white milk and blue cap; wool = fluffy cream ball of wool; flour = small burlap sack of flour with white dust on top; hay = small golden bale of hay tied with twine

Composition: one centered object per cell, three-quarter view, consistent object size across cells, generous padding
Avoid: text, numbers, shadows on the ground, backgrounds, duplicate objects, drop frames
